events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: On September 1st, 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas, aged just 25. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a legend. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture is still felt today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix: a true guitar god who redefined rock music. His influence lives on, decades after his untimely passing.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Beatles album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69. An absolute masterpiece, from that legendary zebra crossing to every single track.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very Happy Birthday. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975, becoming a global message of peace and hope.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with so many. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: It's 25 years since Apple introduced the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember the iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod arrived! Who remembers their first one and what was on your playlist?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your favourite 007 and why? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday on this day. The legendary Beatle was born in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese turns 87 today! What's his most unforgettable moment for you?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. An incredibly diverse record – what are your hidden gems from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, aged 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: A True Champion
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen performance?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their career.

angles.name: Rubber Soul at 61
angles.copy: 61 years since 'Rubber Soul' changed the game for The Beatles. A true classic that showed their incredible evolution.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost John Lennon. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
